item.description: Three local students earn dean’s list honors from UMGC Peyton Fuimaono and Eric Williams of Independence and Jabin Leasure of Blue Springs have been named to the dean’s list for the fall 2025 term for the University of Maryland Global Campus. To be eligible for the honor, a student must complete at least six credits during the term, earned a grade point average of at least 3.5 for the term and maintain a cumulative GPA of 3.5 at UMGC.
